cand.title: FIFAN — 15th International Film Festival of Archaeology of Nyon
cand.excerpt: Strong local, multi-day, international guest mechanism with accessible relationship-development angle.
cand.ledgerVenue: Nyon; exact festival venues not yet fully published

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Verified organizer contacts: Nathalie Pichard, directrice opérationnelle; Auriane Suter, chargée de production. These are the first operational and production/logistics qualification routes, respectively; neither is publicly established as the hotel contracting signatory. Jordan Anastassov is association president; Alexandra Spühler is the current museum curator. Use the shared festival channel contact@fifan.ch / +41 22 316 42 80 and request routing to the accommodation decision-maker. These are organizational, not personal, contact details.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced 15th edition: 31 August–5 September 2027, Nyon, Switzerland, within the requested horizon. The official statement says it “will be held from August 31 to September 5, 2027, in Nyon, Switzerland.” These are activity dates, not publication dates. Exact 2027 venue is not published in the reviewed announcement. The call for works closes 28 February 2027; that is a submission deadline, not a festival date.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel profile: geographically credible Nyon/La Côte lodging relationship, with possible rooms for invited filmmakers, jurors, speakers or production personnel if the organizer confirms non-local attendance and hotel-paid nights. Historical professional workshops support asking about a small ancillary meeting/F&B requirement, not assuming one. YOTEL’s 237 rooms and six meeting rooms do not establish event demand; no evidence supports a 20–120-room block or whole-house use. Founex lodging would require an accepted Nyon transfer plan, especially after evening programming. This is neither a resort-retreat brief nor a downtown-Geneva/Palexpo overflow case.
findings.venueCommitments: 2027 venue: unknown; city: Nyon; region: Vaud / Nyon–La Côte, within the hotel’s primary territory, not Geneva city or Lausanne. No 2027 building or hotel commitment is established. Place du Château 5 is the festival’s c/o museum contact address, not a verified 2027 venue. Historical 2025 programme: Usine à Gaz, Rue César Soulié 1, Nyon, 2–6 September; SuperFIFAN at Musée romain de Nyon, Rue Maupertuis 9, on 7 September. Do not carry those venues forward as 2027 commitments.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified biennial Nyon series, not a rotating international congress: 2019 at Salle communale; 2021 main edition online, with a later award-film screening in Nyon; 2023 at Usine à Gaz; 2025 at Usine à Gaz plus the museum family finale. The calendar shifted from March in 2019/2021/2023 to September in 2025 and August–September in 2027. No destination rotation is evidenced; biennial recurrence does not independently establish dates or a venue after 2027.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown. No official housing bureau, edition-specific host hotel, named room block, open accommodation RFP, guest-hotel allocation or hotel booking pathway was found in the reviewed 2027 announcement/call or historical practical material. The 2027 announcement says “More information about the novelties of the 2027 edition will be revealed soon”; this is not a statement that hotel sourcing is open. The practical-information page still explicitly describes “FIFAN 2025”. Separately, Usine à Gaz’s generic partners page lists “Hôtel de L’Ange, Nyon” under “PRESTATAIRES BAR ET PRODUCTION UàG”. This is the only named hotel found in the reviewed relevant partner material; it is a venue-level supplier listing, not a FIFAN 2027 lodging commitment or room block.
findings.organizationStructure: Association/museum cultural event, not a corporate meeting or sports tournament. Created in 1999 by Musée romain de Nyon and co-organized with Association FIFAN since 2014. The 2026 artistic-director recruitment describes festival management as jointly mandated by the museum and association, working with operational management. No external PCO, DMC or housing agency is identified in reviewed sources. The recruitment concerns programming and identification of guests, not proven hotel purchasing authority; no named incoming artistic director is verified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: No verified FIFAN incumbent hotel, committed rooms, sold-out inventory or overflow evidence found. Hôtel de L’Ange appears only on the generic historical venue supplier page; do not label it the festival’s host hotel. Inference: proximity to Nyon venues, late return transport, guest budget and potentially small organizer-paid demand may limit Founex conversion. The 2025 total of more than 4,000 visitors is a public festival metric, not 4,000 residential delegates, unique overnight guests or room demand.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Nathalie Pichard through contact@fifan.ch, asking to include Auriane Suter. Reference 31 August–5 September 2027 and request: exact venue(s); who books and pays for guest accommodation; existing hotels/commitments; non-local guest categories; peak rooms, arrival/departure pattern and budget; procurement deadline and contracting entity. Offer a conditional, modest guest-room proposal with priced Nyon transfers and optional small briefing/F&B space only after demand is established. Do not reserve a speculative 20–120-room block. If 2027 is committed, request the next accommodation review date and permission for future-cycle follow-up.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the upcoming 2027 edition, dates and city are confirmed, but exact venue, room demand and purchasing access remain unconfirmed. The public operational/production contacts provide a relationship-development route, not proof of an open tender. The 2025 edition is historical and cannot be sold as current open inventory.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: prioritize qualifying 2027 invited-guest accommodation now; if already allocated or too small, seek an introduction for subsequent biennial editions and year-round museum/association workshops. Recurrence is verified, but no post-2027 dates, tender or venue are established. Do not position destination relocation or replacement of the screening venue as the opportunity.
